desc:
🚗 You're stuck at the very back of the biggest traffic jam in the world.
Hundreds of cars ahead. No one knows what awaits at the end.

Your phone just rang... and someone is waiting for you up there. 📱

🔥 Overtake the cars one by one
💰 Earn cash and unlock crazier and crazier rides, from an old hatchback all the way to... a tank
💣 Blow up whatever stands in your way
🏁 Climb the line all the way to first place

Everyone else waits. You overtake.
What's really hiding at the end of the jam? 👀
